units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:5">Ab. IV, 5</cite> <he>וכך הי׳ הלל וכ׳</he> and even so (in the same sense) did Hillel say.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 61a:3">B. Kam. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>כך מקובלני וכ׳</he> such is my tradition from &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 5:9">Tosef. Keth. V, 9</cite> <he>כך תתנו וכ׳</he> even so much (and no more) may you have wherewith to endow your daughters; Bab.
Snh. 66ᵇ; ib. 65ᵃ כך תפסקו; Y. ib. V, end, 30ᶜ כָּכָה; a. fr.—כך וכך so and so many, a certain number, date &c.
R. Hash. 18ᵇ בשנת כך וכך ליוחנן וכ׳ in the year—of John &c.; a. fr.—אחר כך, v. אַחַר.—לְכָךְ (cmp. b. h. לָכֵן) for such a purpose, therefore.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite>, beg. <he>ל׳ דַּקְדֵּק וכ׳</he> therefore be exact in recording the numbers &c.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="E00403"><he>הִילְכָךְ</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00637"><he>לְפִיכָךְ</he></cite>.
